name: Nooglutil
summary: Nooglutyl is a nootropic agent that was studied at the Research Institute of Pharmacology, Russian Academy of Medical Sciences as a potential treatment for amnesia.

uses.text: Nooglutyl is a nootropic agent that was studied at the Research Institute of Pharmacology, Russian Academy of Medical Sciences as a potential treatment for amnesia.

fact.en: It was studied at the Russian Academy of Medical Sciences' pharmacology institute, part of a long Soviet and Russian tradition of research into memory drugs that also produced piracetam's successors.
fact.zh: 它在俄羅斯醫學科學院的藥理研究所被研究，屬於蘇聯與俄羅斯長期研究記憶藥物的傳統，這個傳統也產出了吡拉西坦的後繼藥物。
fact.zhHans: 它在俄罗斯医学科学院的药理研究所被研究，属于苏联与俄罗斯长期研究记忆药物的传统，这个传统也产出了吡拉西坦的后继药物。
